core.title: A Data Paper for Scientific Metadata Benchmarking

data_paper_content_information.Title: A Data Paper for Scientific Metadata Benchmarking
data_paper_content_information.Abstract: The paper introduces the dataset structure, quality control process, and reuse scenarios.
